items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: And one time we had sports, Sun Johnson, and, and, uh, John Handley. Three alto saxophone, working at Taxi Dance.

ctx.x: But he, he got back with the Dixieland. Got perfect with the Dixieland.

That's the time when, uh, Albert Walters took sick, he was on that job. He took sick, and he got John Penny. And one time we had sports, Sun Johnson, and, and, uh, John Handley. Three alto saxophone, working at Taxi Dance. Taxi Dance is a hard thing.
Yeah, well I can't imagine them having three men. Three alto saxophone.
